step1_analysis.description: A cross-coupled dynamic latch used as the resolving stage in a comparator. It uses positive feedback to amplify a small initial voltage difference into full logic levels when triggered by the clock signals.

paper_reference.title: 9.9 A 2.72fJ/conv 13b 2MS/s SAR ADC Using Dynamic Capacitive Comparator with Wide Input Common Mode

latch_delay.description: Time from the 50% point of the clock edge to the output resolving to 90% of VDD.

sky130_expected.calculation: Estimated based on transistor sizes (W=5um, L=0.5um) and load capacitance (10fF). The large widths provide high drive current, but the non-minimum length increases gate capacitance.
sky130_expected.reasoning: With 1.8V supply and large W/L, the latch will resolve quickly, typically in the 100-200ps range depending on the initial voltage difference.

energy_per_conversion.description: Energy consumed from the supply during one latching event.

sky130_expected.calculation: E = C_total * VDD^2. C_total includes gate caps of 6 transistors (W=5u, L=0.5u -> ~25fF each) plus load caps (4x10fF). Total C ~ 190fF. E = 190fF * (1.8V)^2 = 615fJ.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 2.72fJ for the entire ADC at 0.75V in an advanced node. In SKY130 at 1.8V with large L=0.5um transistors, the capacitance and voltage are much higher, leading to significantly higher energy per latching event.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure latch delay and energy per conversion. Ideal switches are used to precharge the internal nodes to a small differential voltage before the clock is asserted.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Dynamic Latch Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VGND GND 0 0

* DUT
XM1 V_DN_2_MINUS V_UP_2_PLUS N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N5 PHI_COMP GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 V_DN_2_PLUS V_UP_2_MINUS N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 V_UP_2_PLUS V_DN_2_MINUS N4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 V_UP_2_MINUS V_DN_2_PLUS N4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N4 PHI_COMP_B VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

* Load capacitors
C1 V_UP_2_PLUS 0 10f
C2 V_UP_2_MINUS 0 10f
C3 V_DN_2_PLUS 0 10f
C4 V_DN_2_MINUS 0 10f

* Precharge circuitry
.model sw_mod sw vt=0.9 ron=100 roff=1G
S1 V_UP_2_PLUS VPRE_P PRECHARGE 0 sw_mod
S2 V_DN_2_MINUS VPRE_N PRECHARGE 0 sw_mod
S3 V_UP_2_MINUS VPRE_N PRECHARGE 0 sw_mod
S4 V_DN_2_PLUS VPRE_P PRECHARGE 0 sw_mod
S5 N4 VDD PRECHARGE 0 sw_mod
S6 N5 0 PRECHARGE 0 sw_mod

VPRE_P VPRE_P 0 0.905
VPRE_N VPRE_N 0 0.895
VPRECHARGE PRECHARGE 0 PWL(0 1.8 0.5n 1.8 0.51n 0)

* Clocks
VPHI_COMP PHI_COMP 0 PWL(0 0 0.6n 0 0.61n 1.8)
VPHI_COMP_B PHI_COMP_B 0 PWL(0 1.8 0.6n 1.8 0.61n 0)

.control
tran 1p 3n
meas tran t_clk find time when v(PHI_COMP)=0.9 rise=1
meas tran t_out find time when v(V_UP_2_PLUS)=1.6 rise=1
let delay = t_out - t_clk
print delay

meas tran q_vdd integ i(VVDD) from=0.6n to=3n
let energy_fJ = -q_vdd * 1.8 * 1e15
print energy_fJ
quit
.endc
